## This is an R package for conducting randomization inference for quantiles of individual treatment effects

### Installation

``` r

devtools::install_github("li-xinran/RIQITE")
```

### load the package

``` r

library(RIQITE)
```

### explanation for the main functions

``` r

?pval_bound # get the p value for testing bounded null

?ci_bound # get the confidence interval for the maximum (or minimum) individual effect

?pval_quantile # get the p value for testing null hypotheses on quantiles of individual effects

?ci_quantile # get the confidence interval for quantiles of individual effects

?calc_power # conduct simulation to compare tests using different Stephenson rank sum statistics

?summary_power_results # summarize the simulation to compare performance of different Stephenson rank sum statistics
```

### A simple example

#### generate the observed data

``` r

n = 200

m = n * 0.5

Z = sample( c( rep(1, m), rep(0, n-m) ) )

Y = rnorm(n) + Z * rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 5)
```

#### choose the test statistic

``` r

method.list = list( name = "Stephenson", s = 10 )
```

#### test the null hypothesis that the 95% quantile of individual effect is less than or equal to 0

``` r

pval = pval_quantile(Z, Y, k = ceiling(n*0.95), c = 0, alternative = "greater", method.list = method.list, nperm = 10^4 )
pval
#> [1] 0
```

#### construct simultaneous confidence intervals for all quantiles of individual effects

``` r

ci = ci_quantile( Z = Z, Y = Y, alternative = "two.sided", method.list = method.list, nperm = 10^4,  alpha = 0.05 )
ci
#> CI quantile on 200 units with 100 treated:
#> Method: Stephenson-10
#> Alternative: two.sided with alpha=0.05
#> Quantiles covered from 1 to 200 (200 quantiles)
#> 10000 permutations with tolerance of 0.001
```

#### visualize the simultaneous confidence intervals for all quantiles of individual effects

``` r

ci.limit = ci$lower
plot( NA, ylab="k", xlab=expression("lower"~"confidence"~"limit"~"for" ~tau[(k)]),
      ylim=c( n+1-sum(is.finite(ci.limit)), n ) + c(-1, 1),
      xlim=range( ci.limit[ci.limit>-Inf] ) + c(-0.5, 1.5) )
for(k in 1:length(ci.limit)){
  lines( c( max( ci.limit[k], min(ci.limit[ci.limit>-Inf]) - 100 ), max(ci.limit)+10),
         rep(k,2), col = "grey" )
}
points( ci.limit, c(1:n), pch = 20, cex = 0.5 )
abline(v = 0, lty = 2)
```

![](reference/figures/README-example-plot-1.png)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`assign_CRE()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/assign_CRE.md)
  : Generate matrix of complete randomization assignments
- [`benin`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/benin.md) :
  Benin Data
- [`birth_school_age`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/birth_school_age.md)
  : Birth-month and school-entry-age instrumental variable illustration
- [`calc_power()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/calc_power.md)
  : Calculate power for the noninferiority null
- [`calc_power_finite()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/calc_power_finite.md)
  : Calculate power or properties of quantile confidence intervals for a
  finite-sample dataset.
- [`ci_bound()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/ci_bound.md)
  : Confidence interval for the maximum or minimum individual effect
- [`ci_quantile()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/ci_quantile.md)
  : Randomization inference for quantiles of individual treatment
  effects
- [`arguments()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/ciresult.md)
  [`is.ciresult()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/ciresult.md)
  [`head(`*`<ciresult>`*`)`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/ciresult.md)
  [`print(`*`<ciresult>`*`)`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/ciresult.md)
  [`summary(`*`<ciresult>`*`)`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/ciresult.md)
  : Result object for results of ci_quantile call
- [`conf_quant_larger()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/conf_quant_larger.md)
  : one-sided confidence interval (c, Inf) for all quantiles
- [`electric_teachers`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/electric_teachers.md)
  : Teachers of Electric Circuits Professional Development
- [`explore_stephenson_s()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/explore_stephenson_s.md)
  : Explore power across a range of s values
- [`explore_stephenson_s_finite()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/explore_stephenson_s_finite.md)
  : Explore power and precision across a range of s values
- [`generate_finite_data()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/generate_finite_data.md)
  : Generate data for power simulation
- [`make_fake_data()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/make_fake_data.md)
  : Make fake dataset for testing and illustration
- [`min_stat()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/min_stat.md)
  : minimum stat value in H_k,c
- [`null_dist()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/null_dist.md)
  : Generate randomization dist of the rank score stat
- [`plot_quantile_CIs()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/plot_quantile_CIs.md)
  : Plot quantile CIs
- [`pval_bound()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/pval_bound.md)
  : Randomization test for bounded null hypotheses
- [`pval_from_null()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/pval_from_null.md)
  : fraction of null draws at least as extreme as the observed statistic
- [`pval_quantile()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/pval_quantile.md)
  : Randomization test for quantiles of individual treatment effects
- [`rank_score()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/rank_score.md)
  : score function of the ranks
- [`sort_treat()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/sort_treat.md)
  : sort the treated units using the "first" method
- [`summary_power_results()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/summary_power_results.md)
  : Summarize set of power simulation results
- [`tx_function_factory()`](https://li-xinran.github.io/RIQITE/reference/tx_function_factory.md)
  : Generate a function that makes treatment effects.
